name: vault_transfer
summary: Move stored ingots, ores and ices from one Ingot Vault's store straight into another's, with the vaults' own bookkeeping; no item is made. Dry run by default; confirm to do it.

help.text: Each line comes off the source as a vend takes it (an ingot's grams of reagent, an ore's or ice's count) and goes onto the target as an import adds it. No item is made and nothing passes a slot, chute, locker or atmosphere, so ices cannot melt on the way. It skips the physical carrying between the vaults, as vault_deposit and vault_withdraw skip it, but creates nothing; not a cheat. Both vaults must be on and powered. Host only.
help.keys: dry_run, from_vault {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, from_via, to_vault, to_via, items {results, count, success_count, error_count}, partial_count.

items.text: Leave items out to move everything the source holds. Otherwise items [{prefab_name, prefab_hash or reagent, quantity}] (up to 256): name each line as vault_contents does (ItemIronIngot or reagent Iron, ItemIce); quantity in grams of ingot or a whole count of ore or ice, default all. More than the source holds moves what it holds, reported partial. Entries naming the same line take from what the earlier ones left. A vault has no capacity limit, so the target takes every line.

reply.text: {dry_run, from_vault, from_via, to_vault, to_via (the Remote Vaults used, or null), items {results [{index, ok, kind, prefab_name, display_name, reagent, requested (null for all), quantity, partial, from {before, after}, to {before, after}}], count, success_count, error_count}, partial_count}. A real run reads after back from both vaults. A refused entry is {index, ok false, asked, error}: not_in_vault, not_enough_stock (earlier entries took it all), invalid_argument (part of an ore or ice). The call refuses same_vault when both ids reach one vault.

clients.text: Both vaults refresh their display and logic slots at once, so an IC or screen reading the vault sees the new store. Joined players get a vault's store only when they join, as with the vault's own imports and vends. A space ice's gas is not kept by the vault's store; a transfer moves counts only.

from_vault_id.description: The vault to take from: an Ingot Vault, or a Remote Vault linked to one.

to_vault_id.description: The vault to store into: an Ingot Vault, or a Remote Vault linked to one.

prefab_name.description: The line as vault_contents names it (ItemIronIngot, ItemIce).

quantity.description: Grams of ingot, or a whole count of ore or ice. Default all.

items.description: The lines to move, each by one of prefab_name, prefab_hash or reagent. Default everything.

dry_run.description: Default true: check and report only.

confirm.description: true with dry_run false to move.
